derivation: Hand-derived, never run. pack2x16float packs IEEE binary16 round to nearest even: 1.0 = 0x3C00, -2.0 = 0xC000, 0.5 = 0x3800, 65504 = 0x7BFF (the largest finite half); 1e6 saturates to 65504 and NaN packs 0. unpack2x16float reads the low half first. oct_encode divides by |x|+|y|+|z| and folds the lower hemisphere with (1 - |p.yx|) sign(p.xy); oct_decode inverts it and normalises, so the round trip returns the input within 1e-3. pack_reservoir: x = slot & 0xFF; uv [0.5, 0.25] gives low 0x3800 and high 0x3400; [2, 20] gives low 0x4000 and high 0x4D00; a zero normal gives 0. EMPTY is slot 0xFF with every other field zero.

pack2x16float.note: 1.0 is 0x3C00 in bits 0-15, -2.0 is 0xC000 in bits 16-31
0.5 is 0x3800 in bits 0-15, 65504 (HALF_MAX) is 0x7BFF in bits 16-31
1e6 saturates to HALF_MAX 0x7BFF in bits 0-15, NaN packs 0

unpack2x16float.note: low half 0xC000 is -2.0, high half 0x3C00 is 1.0

oct_encode.note: p = [0, 0], z < 0 folds to (1 - 0) * sign(0) = 1 per axis

oct_roundtrip.note: z < 0 folds xy to [0.571429, -1], decode folds back to [0, -0.6, -0.8]

pack_reservoir.note: weight 1e6 clamps to HALF_MAX, z low half 0x7BFF and high half 0

unpack_reservoir.note: the saturated weight unpacks as HALF_MAX
the EMPTY reservoir keeps slot 0xFF and zero elsewhere
